    • withValue

      public DropdownBoxBuilder withValue(String value)
      Sets the initial selected value for the dropdown box. WARNING: The value must correspond to the "name" of one of the entries added via addEntry(DropdownEntryInfo) or withEntries(List). If the value does not exist in the entries, the dropdown may exhibit unexpected behavior or fail to show the selection.
      Parameters:
      value - The name of the entry to select.
      Returns:
      This builder instance for method chaining.
